title: 第13章 十日内入山斩狼妖第14章 请神术请彰越公神威降临
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“吾听闻千狼山中有狼妖肆虐，为祸百姓。”
“你既为吾之庙祝，自当斩妖除魔，为民除害。”
“十日内，入山斩狼妖。”
威严浩瀚的声音传来。
李有鸣恭恭敬敬的叩拜着，虔诚道：
“李有鸣谨遵彰越公神谕！”
话音落下。
面前的梦境世界立即崩碎。
……
房间中，李有鸣清醒过来。
他脑海中依旧在回荡着‘十日内，入山斩狼妖’的威严声音。
那声音神威无量。
仅仅只是听到都让人升不起任何杂念！
“这是彰越公下达的第二次神谕……”
“我一定要办得漂亮。”
李有鸣目光闪闪，微微握紧了拳。
作为庙祝，完成神只下达的神谕就是头等大事！
他的一切——
都是来自于神只。
现在只有他一位庙祝。

以后会不会还有其它庙祝？
现在为彰越公将事情办得越完美，以后哪怕有了其余庙祝自己的地位也不会受到动摇。
依旧会是彰越公最为看重的庙祝！
居安思危。
他一直都懂得这个道理。
至于怎么才能把这次神谕办得漂亮？
他稍稍沉吟，已经有了主意。
打开房门，他看着还待在门外的长子，开口道：
“去将村长、副村长叫过来。”
四海村村长自然还是李德阳，而副村长则是原陈家村村长陈麻子。
很快——
李德阳和陈麻子就匆匆赶了过来。
“有鸣叔，什么事情？”
三人在房间中坐下，李德阳沉声道。
陈麻子也看着李有鸣。
他们都清楚，若不是有大事发生，李有鸣一般不会找他们两人。
村里的事情。
李有鸣只管信仰，其他事务一概不理。
不过在村子里。
李有鸣的地位却是毫无疑问的最高！

“彰越公有神谕传下！”
李有鸣面容沉肃道。
神谕！
李德阳面色顿时严肃了起来，甚至都站起了身。
陈麻子也跟着站起。
content_en:
"I heard that there is a wolf monster wreaking havoc in Qianlang Mountain, causing harm to the people."
"Since you are blessing my temple, you should kill demons and eliminate harm for the people."
"Within ten days, enter the mountain and kill the wolf demon."
A majestic and vast voice came.
Li Youming bowed respectfully and said piously:
"Li Youming sincerely obeys the oracle of Zhang Yue Gong!"
The words fell.
The dream world in front of him immediately collapsed.
…
In the room, Li Youming woke up.
The majestic voice of 'Go into the mountain and kill the wolf demon within ten days' was still echoing in his mind.
That voice was so powerful.
Just hearing it makes people unable to have any distracting thoughts!
"This is the second oracle issued by Duke Zhang Yue..."
"I must do it beautifully."
Li Youming's eyes flashed and he clenched his fists slightly.
As a temple blessing, fulfilling the oracle issued by the gods is the top priority!
Everything about him——
They all come from gods.
Now he is the only one worshiping the temple.
Will there be other temple blessings in the future?
The more perfect things can be done for Duke Zhangyue now, the more his status will not be shaken even if there are other temples in the future.
It will still be the most important temple blessing for Duke Zhangyue!
Be prepared for danger in times of peace.
He has always known this.
As for how to make this oracle beautiful?
He pondered for a moment and already had an idea.
Opening the door, he looked at his eldest son who was still outside the door and said:
"Go and call the village chief and deputy village chief over."
The chief of Sihai Village is naturally still Li Deyang, and the deputy chief is Chen Mazi, the former chief of Chenjia Village.
Soon——
Li Deyang and Chen Mazi hurried over.
"Uncle Ming, what's going on?"
The three of them sat down in the room, and Li Deyang said in a deep voice.
Chen Mazi also looked at Li Youming.
They all knew that if something big didn't happen, Li Youming would usually not come to find them.
Things in the village.
Li Youming only cared about his faith and ignored other matters.
But in the village.
Li Youming's status is undoubtedly the highest!
"The oracle has been handed down by Duke Zhangyue!"
Li Youming said with a serious face.
oracle!
Li Deyang's expression suddenly became serious and he even stood up.
Chen Mazi also stood up.
